verdict.rationale: Paxos documents an API for converting between supported assets [paxos-docs-10]. It also documents one-call mint (USD to stablecoin) and redeem (stablecoin to USD) orchestrations [paxos-docs-8, paxos-docs-9, paxos-docs-41], plus fiat deposit and withdrawal APIs and transfer listing and status polling [paxos-docs-37, paxos-docs-35, paxos-docs-36], so fiat↔stablecoin movement via the API is clearly delivered. Dashboard evidence covers only the Sandbox Fund button [paxos-docs-46]. missing for 10: a documented dashboard flow for conversion and rebalancing, explicit internal transfers between profiles or sub-accounts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
